description: Gate: service_shape Off parks the row (mode park); the grade is still computed (ICP-2 → Gold) and stored — only the status changes (PRO-0).
Gate: economics fail parks the row (mode park); the ICP-1 Gold grade is computed underneath.
Unclassified: no ICP stated and no facts to derive one from (is_agency and agency_type null). No tier, no cell; unknown never fires a gate.
Platinum rule: ICP-1 (evidence) Gold, Partner ceiling from headroom ≥ $100K with one climb signal, 4 of 4 Dimension A facts → Platinum × Partner, confidence High.
Climb-evidence cap: ICP-2 Gold with headroom ≥ $100K but no climb signal → ceiling capped to Project, flagged; platinum rule fails on ceiling → Gold × Project.
ADJ-WL: ICP-3 Bronze with wl_signal High → +1 → Silver. Headroom $35K–100K with a climb signal → Embedded.
Net cap +1: ICP-3 with two positives (ADJ-WL and ADJ-REF both fire, raw +2) is capped to +1 → Silver, never Gold.
PRO-4 direct-to-client: ICP-6 base Silver; agency-only rules skipped (wl_signal High and niche_positioning true do not fire) while ADJ-REF still applies → Gold; flagged Direct-to-client.
ADJ-ICP4-UNPROVEN: ICP-4 Gold in an unproven vertical → −1 → Silver.
Conversation row: zero Dimension A facts. min_facts_to_publish_tier is 0 so the tier (ICP-2 → Gold) is still published with the Conversation label; fit confidence Low.
Override within the one-tier cap: computed Gold, owner override to Silver with reason code → Overridden, effective Silver.

override.reason: Known partner of a competitor; slow to move.

description: Override beyond the cap is refused: computed Bronze (ICP-3), override to Gold is two tiers → flag 'Override refused: beyond one-tier cap', status stays Ranked, Bronze stands.
Lapsed-client lineage (PRO-14) from an uncertified roster source: flags 'Lapsed client' and 'Roster source uncertified'; trailing revenue reduces headroom.
Year one from a quote: quote_amount $52,000 → year1_band '$46K–100K' (basis quote), overriding the ICP-3 prior band.

A negative signal that does not decay: neg_champion_left (−8, lifespan 90, decays false) 45 days old counts at full −8 and drags the total below the Warm rung; the warm intro (10, decaying) still routes a 48h task.
Stated timing wins: timing within_1_week → Super Hot (basis stated_timing) although the only signal is a nearly-expired manual note that would compute Cold.
Deal health red on three close-date pushes (DH-PUSHES); a next meeting is booked and the buyer touched us five days ago, so nothing else fires. The reason sentence carries the deal.
Stated ICP wins over derivation: stated ICP-3 while the facts derive ICP-1 (full_service, 30 people, $5–10M) → base from ICP-3 (Bronze) and the flag 'ICP disagrees with derivation'.
Derived ICP: nothing stated; boutique with deep single vertical derives ICP-4 (step 5) → Gold. An unexpired orbit_pa_signed signal raises its catalog flag and an 8h-default task.
Headroom unknown (headcount null): the stated ceiling Embedded stands in, a climb signal lets it hold; flags 'Headcount unknown'; potential confidence Medium.
Economics derived from a stated deal size below the $2K floor → fail → Parked; broker_character flag raises 'Broker character flag' only (mode flag, PRO-2r-a open).
Prior grade differs: an earlier list said Platinum, the engine computes Gold → flag; a prior value 'A' is not a tier word and is ignored.
Routing: two medium signals (cluster_hiring, leadership_change) inside the 30-day window make one task at the default SLA; their decayed total lands on the Hot rung (computed).

Deal health, unknown_never_warns: two open deals with next_meeting_at null. d-24a has no has_next_meeting (Pipedrive activities never read) and is 25 days dark — UNKNOWN, so neither DH-DARK nor DH-NO-NEXT fires and it is green. d-24b carries has_next_meeting false (activities read, none booked) → yellow DH-NO-NEXT only. ICP-2 Gold; headroom 18 × $175K × 20% × 50% × 0.5 = $157,500 → Partner proposed, capped to Project (no climb signal); no signals → Cold; year one from the ICP-2 prior band.

Potential confidence Medium on an evidence headcount with the WL signal unknown: 24 people from LinkedIn (evidence), wl_signal null → the High rule fails on the WL clause and the evidence-headcount Medium rule fires (not Low). ICP-2 Gold inferred, money and authority present → Partly qualified, fit confidence Medium. Headroom 24 × $175K × 20% (default share) × 50% × 0.5 = $210,000 → Partner proposed, capped to Project (no climb signal); no signals → Cold; year one from the ICP-2 prior band.
